summary: A minus / value / plus control that changes a number by `step`, clamped to [min, max], then runs `onDecrement` or `onIncrement` (and any `onClick`). Each button is a 36 dp circle in a 48 dp touch target.

value.doc: The number. Bind a document variable to read it ("@guests"); omitted, the stepper keeps its own, starting at `initial` 0

decimals.doc: Digits after the point in the value (use with a fractional step)

label.doc: What is counted, in lower case ("guests"): the buttons are announced as "Decrease guests" and "Increase guests"; empty, just Decrease and Increase

onIncrement.doc: Actions run on every tap of plus, after the step (hostNamedAction, valueFloatChange, ...), e.g. [{"type": "hostNamedAction", "name": "more"}]

onDecrement.doc: Actions run on every tap of minus, after the step, e.g. [{"type": "hostNamedAction", "name": "less"}]

onClick.doc: Actions run on every tap of minus AND plus, after the step and after onDecrement/onIncrement. Only for actions without a hostNamedAction name (valueFloatChange, ...): a named action used by both buttons reaches the host with no name from one of them; tell the host with onIncrement/onDecrement instead. Omitted (with the other two): a tap only changes `value`

pitfalls: textFromFloat `whole` is the number of integer digits kept, not a minimum: whole 1 prints 10 as 0. The value uses whole 3 with flags 5 (no padding), so it stays centred
The buttons clamp with max(@min, @value - @step) and min(@max, @value + @step): a value outside [min, max] set by the host is pulled back on the next tap
The buttons are announced as Decrease and Increase, followed by `label` when given ("Decrease guests"); put the stepper next to a KeyValueRow key that names the quantity

`onDecrement` / `onIncrement` run after the clamped step of their own button, `onClick` after both: an app reading the exported `value` on a hostNamedAction sees the new number (and is told even when a tap at min or max changed nothing)
Give a hostNamedAction to onIncrement / onDecrement, never to onClick: a named action written in two click lists is registered with the first list only, so the other button sends it with no name
Each button is a 36 dp circle inside 6 dp of padding, so its click target is 48 × 48 dp; the whole stepper is 148 × 48 dp, with 12 dp of visible space between a circle and the number
